_comment: Idle Shutdown Relay ECM output - STP 8.5.7.2: RMS voltage on CH1, referenced to battery ground. Single channel, 2 V/div (use 5 for 24 V ECM calibrations), vertical position -3.5 div, 2 ms/div, edge trigger on CH1 rising at half of battery voltage, NORMal (single-shot) mode. Plain numbers in the scope's native units: vertical_scale in V/div, vertical_position in divisions, trigger_position in %, record_length in points, trigger_level "half_battery" = half of battery_voltage. The capture window is NOT stored in the config; set it per call with configure_scope(..., duration_s=SECONDS), which sets s/div = duration_s/10. WINDOW: pass duration_s=0.02 to configure_scope for this test (0.02 s total = 0.002 s/div x 10).
name: idle_shutdown_relay
